correctness.rationale: Exact positive compositions give a log-ratio \(z[(1-s)-s\rho(e^{-sz}-e^{-z})]\). Its sole controlling function has unique strict maximum at \(-\log s/(1-s)\), height \((1-s)s^{s/(1-s)}\), proving the iff boundary, all equality cases, sign intervals, and R2 invariance. The nonzero quadratic curvature proves square-root splitting. Exact rational signs and an independent standard-library checker (8,000 composition identities and 2,207 two-root parameter cases) reproduce the examples without substituting finite evidence for the proof.

originality.rationale: No checked source states or demonstrably implies the exact single-harvest, two consecutive Ricker recruitments, two initial-stock crossings with critical pressure \(s^{-1/(1-s)}\). Ricker and Abrams provide antecedent density-overcompensation mechanisms, and Liz/Hilker plus Grey et al. treat recurring/within-season controls with distinct quantifiers and objectives. A finite-horizon single-pulse composition comparison requires the separate strict unimodality argument supplied here. Historical full-text and broad-coverage risks remain material and are not claimed to be eliminated.

Numerical checks do not establish global historical priority; distinct scientific discovery may require independent literature verification.

value.rationale: Provides a closed necessary-and-sufficient regime with precisely two initial-stock reversals for the natural finite two-season single-harvest management question, a new boundary beyond the known qualitative hydra phenomenon. The cross-season pressure is a dimensionless ecological combination, the second-season uncrowded factor cancels, and the phenomenon can occur inside a stable unharvested Ricker regime. One recruitment season has no such reversal, establishing a motivated minimal intervention horizon rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
